critical_failures: The deterministic final workflow verifier exited 1.
Task 2 leaves semicolon-delimited genre values from MediaFile unsplit, violating hidden cumulative acceptance.
software_quality.review_method: independent practical-software-quality-reviewer delegate; manifest, concealed verifier, source diff, and evidence-bundle review
review_findings: The only final acceptance failure was test_read_semicolon_delimited_genres: item.genres was ['Jazz; Funk; Soul'] instead of ['Jazz','Funk','Soul']; task-2 reported 1 failed and 15 passed, while task-1 and task-3 verifier phases passed.
The root cause is precise: DelimitedString.normalize handles list values by splitting only self.db_delimiter, bypassing parse(), whose fallback recognizes the '; ' display delimiter.

Agent validation covered scalar 'Jazz; Funk' and list entries containing MULTI_VALUE_DELIMITER, but omitted the MediaFile round-trip/list-entry case using '; '; later focused tests repeated the same gap.
The cumulative diff is focused and reviewable: 40 insertions and 25 deletions across the 15 scoped production files, with no test edits, generated noise, or unrelated framework changes.
No hidden-test skipping or test manipulation was detected: verifier hashes remained unchanged at every checkpoint; visible pytest deselections came from intentional focused -k selections, not skips.
Verifier qualification established that the fixed cumulative verifier passes and the composite seeded verifier fails; runtime verifier-integrity checks and the compact-artifact manifest also passed.

Raw diagnostics are recoverable. An earlier converter-suite failure caused by the preseeded future genre regression was diagnosed and subsequently repaired, but the final-only concealed failure occurred after the last agent turn, leaving no recovery opportunity.
Tool-isolation audit passed with no forbidden-tool, unsupported-command, or external-retrieval hits; no safety or credential exposure was found in the production diff.
Because final functional verification failed, the session is ineligible for the individual_tool_effectiveness objective regardless of otherwise valid token accounting and isolation evidence.

critical_failures: Task 3 is under-solved: internal/command/meta_config.go::loadConfig still uses strict ParseVariableValues instead of ParseConstVariableValues, contrary to the disclosed early-loading contract and pinned fixed snapshot; non-const required variables can therefore be rejected during early configuration loading.
software_quality.review_method: independent practical-software-quality-reviewer delegate; manifest, concealed verifier, source diff, and evidence-bundle review
review_findings: Artifact integrity passed: all manifest checksums, gzip integrity, and the frozen-protocol SHA-256 match.
The final verifier exited 0, all three verifier scripts passed, and verifier-integrity checks found no missing or changed verifier assets at any checkpoint.

No explicit test skips or test-file edits appear in the candidate diff; however, four adapter packages were compile-only under the verifier's regex and reported [no tests to run], leaving meaningful behavior untested.
The final cumulative patch is an exact inverse of the composite regression in 14 of 19 production files; five files retain deviations from the pinned fixed snapshot.

The task-3 verifier exercises strict parsing and selected init success cases but does not exercise the residual loadConfig early-loading defect, so its functional pass is insufficient for objective acceptance.

Task 2 restores ComputedBlocksAllowed across the disclosed adapters, but ConfigureProvider remains an ad hoc capability reconstruction and MockEvalContext still omits StorePlannedPrivate relative to the fixed snapshot, reducing consistency and maintainability.

Raw diagnostics are recoverable. Archived red Go-test commands fail at sandbox-denied IPv6 httptest listeners rather than recorded assertions; later bounded tests and compilation checks are preserved rather than hidden.

Isolation evidence reports no forbidden-tool or external-retrieval hits, verifier assets remained concealed, credential material is redacted or absent, and provider-token totals reconcile exactly with raw usage blocks.
No independent rerun was performed because the compact bundle contains no archived candidate checkout; conclusions are grounded in checksum-bound evidence and in-memory diff comparison.
